g.text: FUNCTION SET
F01 short standing half-lean recovery · F02 preserve passage · F03 avoid bench reading · F04 reversible/non-destructive install
F05 valid verified load path [UNVERIFIED] · F06 drain/clean · F07 inspect/replace · F08 avoid unsupported edge/climb implication
DEPENDENCY BEFORE COMBINATION
F04 attachment ↔ F05 load transfer are COUPLED.
F02 passage ↔ F03 affordance ↔ F08 edge are a shared geometry bundle.
C-A · HOST-DEPENDENT RIGID CLAMP
Rigid contact + reversible clamp
Matches Current causal family; replay does not independently validate it.
Causal architecture
body → shallow rigid surface → clamp → existing rail → existing base
Strength of family
Minimal floor footprint; reversible/serviceable relation can remain explicit.
HOLD / falsifier
Host rail/base load capacity, clamp slip/local damage, edge and clearance.
F05 + F08 NOT VERIFIED
C-B · INDEPENDENT NARROW LEAN ELEMENT
Rigid contact + independent support
Genuine alternative: removes host-rail load dependence but occupies ground.
existing rail may remain only as edge guard
Causal architecture
body → shallow rigid surface → independent legs/base → walking surface/foundation
Strength of family
Potentially separates recovery load path from unverified existing rail.
HOLD / falsifier
Passage width, base/foundation, drainage, permission or edge relation fail.
F02 + F05 + F08 NOT VERIFIED
C-C · HOST-DEPENDENT COMPLIANT TENSION
Compliant band + distributed host transfer
Genuine alternative: changes contact mechanics and load-transfer topology.
Causal architecture
body → compliant tension band → distributed host points → existing rail/base
Strength of family
Low floor footprint; distinctly different contact/deflection behavior.
HOLD / falsifier
Deflection, pinch/entrapment, dynamic envelope or host load transfer fails.
F02 + F05 + F08 UNKNOWN / CONDITIONAL
COMPATIBILITY / DEDUP READBACK
INCOMPATIBLE: host-rail sleeve principle + independent floor support; local sleeve + suspended tension architecture.
UNKNOWN: compliant band + clamp requires real deflection/contact prototype plus structural attachment verification.
No material-only / fastener-only / small-dimension tuning is counted as another concept family.
DISPOSITION
KEEP Current authority. Replay is method evidence only.
Technical + human + field tests remain NOT_RUN.
